scope: Automatic bounded skeleton prediction copies, reusable movement settings, controllable character sandbox and matching in-place game exports.
sourcePolicy: Only the freshly supplied 3d-lab(8).zip used as application source. Kestrel source was not modified. No older Lab or cApp code merged.
changes: Cancellable off-main-thread QEM simplification for UniRig; original high-detail mesh retained.
Candidate review reports inference and original counts; existing Apply/Discard/Undo protection remains.
Optional validated movement profile with idle/walk/run/start/stop and directional slots, trims, speeds and blend timing.
Interruptible acceleration/braking, root X/Z removal, normalized walk/run phase and loop-seam smoothing.
Third-person/POV sandbox, keyboard and mouse input, optional pointer capture, NPC test, additive head/chest look and two-parent hand IK with separate influence controls.
Game movement prompt starters and contextual guidance.
Matching game-clip GLB and movement-recipe exports with provenance and original draft/key preservation.
preserved: capp.3d-lab.assets.v1 identity and original source assets.
Detailed mesh geometry, materials and saved skin weights.
Existing action/rig recipes and history; movement field is optional for older recipes.
All supplied vendor and extracted authoring modules unchanged.
Existing native model engines and checkpoints.

sandboxChecks: empty-action model has a usable sandbox with clear fallback guidance
existing editable actions feed idle, walk, run and interruptible start/stop slots
WASD accelerates, Shift runs, release brakes, and rest is reached
short taps and direction reversal interrupt transitions without waiting for a cycle
typing and focus loss never leave movement keys held
POV, turning, head/hand aiming, pausing and NPC test run in the actual renderer
bad settings stay visible and cannot overwrite the accepted profile
game export contains trimmed in-place clips, a rig and movement metadata
keeping settings leaves source keys intact and Undo restores the prior draft
responsive modal and keyboard focus work at 390px; repeated open/close retains editor
saved draft reopens with movement settings and original keys after reload
dense mesh is automatically prepared in the real worker and original detail returns with candidate
applying a proxy-derived candidate keeps full detail and one Undo restores weights/actions/settings
cancelling preparation never sends a partial mesh and retains source and engine
browser.scope: Real Linux Chromium WebGL, local Blob worker, IndexedDB, GLB loading/export. Controlled native UniRig replies only; no actual neural inference in this release.

visualReview: Desktop and 390px mobile sandbox inspected; separate POV/aim view inspected before packaging. Screenshots retained for internal QA only.
limitations: Windows/WebView2 and RTX/CUDA inference not executed here. Existing native model versions unchanged.
Actual neural skeleton quality and ordered AI start/stop prompt compliance are not established by fixtures.
Flat-ground sandbox has no collision, physics, foot locking, contact solver, navigation or weapon attachment system.
Blocked Blob workers, timeout or protected geometry that cannot meet inference bounds fail visibly with original retained.
Game exports contain clips and controller settings; another game engine requires an adapter for interactive movement. No Kestrel integration.
